scope: Corollary 3.5 (Small strong models) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (S, ∆) be an effective rational dlt pair on a normal compact Kähler space, with rational-line adjoint. Suppose that an effective rational Cartier divisor D satisfies Supp D = Supp⌊∆⌋. There is a projective small morphism h : Y → S, with Y globally strongly Q-factorial and compact Kähler, which is crepant for the full adjoint and is an isomorphism over the smooth locus of S. The transformed full pair is dlt. The same assertion for an ordinary klt pair allows D = 0.
